**Why it matters:** Understanding the shared mechanistic link involving APP processing and amyloid deposition could lead to the development of therapeutic strategies targeting common pathways for both ACys amyloidosis and APP-related cerebral amyloid angiopathy, potentially including inhibitors of APP processing or agents that promote amyloid clearance.
